messages:
Jordan: PSA — spilled my cold brew all over my keyboard at 10:02am. rip, it's in pieces on my desk. 
Ava: nooooo keyboard sacrifice :cry: did you try to power it on?
Jordan: unplugged immediately, towel + paper towels. tossed keys in rice for now. switched to my backup USB keyboard.
Marcus: always keep a backup keyboard. also move beverages to the far side of the desk. learned that the hard way. :sweat_smile:
Lena: pro tip — cheap silicone keyboard covers are the best $10 you will ever spend. waterproof enough for accidental coffee. link: https://example.com/keyboard-cover (not sponsored)
Sam: i have a spare basic USB keyboard you can borrow if you want. i live nearby — can drop off.
Jordan: omg yes please. that would save my afternoon. :pray:
CoffeeBot: Friendly reminder: coffee delivery scheduled for 2024-08-10. Don't spill it this time. :coffee:
Ava: also curious — anyone tried an actual spill-proof keyboard (rated IP67)? are they worth the $$$ for WFH?
Marcus: i tried a rugged keyboard for a warehouse project. it survived a soda dump but typing feel was meh. good for kids/pets though.
Lena: poll: should we have a WFH gear-swap channel? react :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for no.
Sam: :thumbsup: will bring the spare keyboard in 20 mins.
Jordan: update 10:20am — spare keyboard saved my standup. keys are sticky but alive. drying rig: keyboard upside-down on a towel + fan.
Ava: glad standup survived. maybe we need a "no-drinks-near-keyboard" emoji policy.
Marcus: agreed. also recommend a small coaster with a lip. keeps mugs from migrating.
Jordan: thanks everyone. sending a photo later of my new temporary keyboard battlestation and the soggy survivor. cat tried to adopt the rice bowl as a bed. :cat2:
